content:
Geometry in Class 2 covers flat and solid shapes, their faces, edges and vertices, symmetry and patterns — visual, high-scoring Olympiad content. Here is what the IMO Class 2 geometry chapter tests, the shape facts to know cold, and a free 10-question test.

What the Class 2 Maths Olympiad Geometry chapter tests

  • 2-D shapes and their sides and corners
  • 3-D shapes — faces, edges and vertices
  • Lines and curves
  • Symmetry and patterns

Key facts your child should know

  • A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners; a square has 4 equal sides.
  • A cube and a cuboid each have 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.
  • A cylinder has 3 faces, 2 edges and 0 vertices; a cone has 2 faces, 1 edge and 1 vertex; a sphere has 1 curved face.
  • A shape has a line of symmetry if a fold makes two matching halves.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Mixing up edges and vertices on a solid.
  • Calling every box a cube — a cube has all equal sides.
  • Continuing a pattern by the wrong feature (colour vs shape).

quiz.title: IMO Class 2 Geometry Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten Olympiad-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: A bead string reads blue, yellow, blue, blue, yellow, blue. Which bead goes on next?
questions.explanation: The block "blue, yellow, blue" repeats again and again, so after 6 items the next one is blue.

questions.q: Riddle: I am a solid with 6 square faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices, like a dice. Who am I?
questions.explanation: A dice is a cube: 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices, and every face is a square.

questions.q: An egg is most like which flat shape?
questions.explanation: An egg is a stretched round shape — an oval.

questions.q: Count the sides of a hexagon. How many are there?
questions.explanation: Hexa means six — a hexagon has 6 straight sides.

questions.q: Riya draws a pentagon using only straight lines. How many lines does she draw?
questions.explanation: Each side of a pentagon is one straight line, and a pentagon has 5 sides.

questions.q: A cylinder, shaped like a cold-drink can, has how many faces?
questions.explanation: A cylinder has 2 flat circle faces and 1 curved face — 3 faces in all.

questions.q: How many more faces than edges does a cylinder have?
questions.explanation: A cylinder has 3 faces and 2 edges: 3 - 2 = 1.

questions.q: Which solid can both roll on its curved side and slide on its flat faces?
questions.explanation: A cylinder rolls on its curved surface and slides on its two flat circle faces.

questions.q: To draw one square, how many straight lines must you draw?
questions.explanation: Each side of a square is one straight line, and a square has 4 sides.

questions.q: Riddle: I have exactly one side more than a square. Which shape am I?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 sides, so I have 4 + 1 = 5 sides — a pentagon.

faq.q: How many faces does a cube have?
faq.a: Six, plus 12 edges and 8 vertices. A cuboid (like a brick) has the same counts.
A vertex is a corner — the point where edges meet on a solid shape.
